messages:
Sonia: Ok team — starting a short recruitment sprint for a latency-focused beta (target 6–8 partners). Goal: real e-comm personalization workloads hitting sub-150ms tail for interactive flows. Need: selection criteria, outreach copy, eval plan, and acceptance gates. Can we move fast this week?
Devon: I can run capacity estimates once we have average seq len + QPS. Also want to know if we require truth-labeled eval traffic or synthetic replay.
Riley: For latency we'd need sequence distribution (avg + 95th token count) and concurrency targets. If targets are small (<=8 concurrent) we can probably meet <150ms with batching tuned; higher concurrency changes routing.
Priya: Outreach: OEM partners + existing retail signups. Suggest approach: 1) invite email to product leads, 2) 15m pre-screen call, 3) 4-week pilot. Incentive: $2k credit + spotlight case study. Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Marcus: Legal: we'll need a short pilot NDA (2 weeks turnaround ideally) and a data handling addendum if they want to replay real customer data. Note: no PHI. If any health-adjacent claims, escalate.
Sonia: Candidate profile: mid-market retailers with personalization infra, willing to send ~1k daily sessions for replay, product contact + infra contact. Priority: partners that care about latency (checkout, chat, product recs). Airtable to track: https://airtable.com/shrExamplePilotBoard
Priya: Draft outreach (short):

```
Subject: Pilot invite — low-latency personalization with Redwood Dedicated
Hi [Name],
We’re running a short pilot to validate sub-150ms personalization for checkout/chat flows. 4 weeks, reserved capacity, $2k credits + implementation help. Interested in a 15m call?
—Sonia, Product
```

Devon: Quick acceptance gates proposal:
- Integration completed (SDK/webhook) within 7 days
- 3 days of stable traffic replay without errors
- p95 latency < 200ms for pilot week 2+ (goal <150ms)
- No security/PII violations

If gates pass, we'll extend to production readout & SLA talk.
Riley: Eval harness idea: collect 1k representative requests, run 3 modes: hosted baseline, dedicated unoptimized, dedicated tuned (batching + cache). Metric set: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail variance, token cost per response, error rate. Quick snippet for load runner:```bash
hey-load --targets requests.json --concurrency 6 --mode replay
```
Devon: I'll run a quick capacity calc today. Rough numbers: for 6 partners with avg seq 150 tokens and 8 concurrent sessions we estimate ~0.6 GPU-days/week across two n1-gpus (quantized). Will refine.
Priya: Outreach plan cadence: email -> 15m call -> pilot kickoff -> weekly async feedback + 1 mid-pilot check. Who owns the pre-screen calls?
Sonia: I can own pre-screens this week. @Riley you'll own the integration checklist; @Devon you'll own capacity estimates and cost comms; @Priya you run outreach + calendar. Marcus will review NDA.
Devon: noted. I'll post a short spreadsheet with cost buckets and a sample quote to present on calls.
Marcus: I'll draft a one-page pilot NDA and post to the Airtable record. ETA tomorrow EOD.
@dp-bot: pull signups for "latency-pilot" channel
dp-bot: 3 new signups added to Airtable (ids 412, 413, 414) — no red flags detected
Sonia: Great — let's sync 30m tomorrow 11am to triage candidates and finalize templates. Action items: Sonia = pre-screens; Priya = send email list; Riley = integration checklist; Devon = cost calc; Marcus = NDA.
Priya: I'll drop the first batch of outreach tonight and ping here with responses. :rocket:
